components.summary: Version 2: evidence-backed failure guidance; separate graph/format checks from chemical ranking, avoid unsupported size/frequency priors, recover locally from network errors, and finish with visible text.
Compare reaction families, sites and precursor identities using the parsed graph and chemistry; do not force three candidates, hidden-reference priors or minimal-atom ranking.
Reference implementation: enumerate candidate reactant sets with a named-transform library.
Reference implementation: mechanical per-candidate scoring (validity, atom budget, MCS coverage, changed sites).
Reference implementation: output-contract battery plus RDKit-canonical rewrite of the answer file.
